issues.explanation: In 「もうこりごりだ」, もう means “already; quite/thoroughly,” not “anymore.”
In 「稀になって」, に is the continuative form of the copula だ, not a particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Set type to auxiliary, lemma to だ, and meaning to “being/becoming.”

issues.explanation: The overlay offsets 99–102 select 「を残さず」 rather than 「残さず」.
ず attaches to the verb’s irrealis form (未然形), not generally to the verb stem.
issues.suggested_fix: Describe ず as attaching to the 未然形 残さ.

issues.explanation: The overlay offsets 133–137 select 「の吹かな」 rather than 「吹かない」.
The overlay offsets 145–150 select 「稀になって」 and do not include から.
issues.suggested_fix: Use start 147 and end 152 for 「なってから」.

issues.explanation: The overlay offsets 165–172 select only 「ような気がす」 and omit the final る.
The overlay offsets 200–203 select 「。人が」 rather than 「来れば」.
